messages:
Maya Chen: Heads-up — Tortoise Data POC is blocked on a couple of enterprise asks from CISO. They want: SSO/SAML + KMS attestation, a perf run with Dedicated capacity, and an explicit pilot pricing commitment. Timeline: want pilot to start next Monday (3 weeks). Need exec OK for temporary Dedicated + pilot discount so we can sign the addendum. SQ link (internal): https://redwood/SQ/TD-2026 — currently 96/120 answered. Outstanding: KMS rotation policy, egress encryption diagram, subprocessors list. @Marcus Vega tagging for pricing/exec -> :rotating_light:
Ravi Patel: +1. Sales needs a short yes/no on the discount and whether Eng can spin Dedicated quickly. Customer will only move forward if we commit to the pilot pricing and a Dedicated pool for throughput tests. They expect peak ~1.5k rps, median seq ~2k tokens.
Lena Ortiz: I can draft a 3-week pilot addendum and DPA addendum. I can approve up to 20% discount on my own; anything >20% needs exec signoff (Marcus). Also need the customer legal contact to attach the addendum. For KMS attestation we need the template filled — Security team provides it, we don't create one from scratch.
Dan S.: We can provision a Dedicated pool in eu-west-1 (8 GPUs equivalent) and pin the model variant. Quick notes: will need SAML metadata file and a list of allowed egress IPs or VPC peering. We can disable autoscale for the baseline perf run. CLI for provisioning (internal):
```
redwoodctl capacity allocate --type dedicated --gpus 8 --region eu-west-1 --expires 2026-06-20 --note "Tortoise POC"
```
But we need either a PO or a billing waiver for the short-term allocation — finance will not accept open allocations without a PO.
Marcus Vega: I can approve up to 25% pilot discount for 3 weeks and temporary Dedicated capacity, provided Legal signs the addendum and Security signs the KMS attestation. Conditions: (1) Sales to collect customer legal contact and PO or billing agreement; (2) Eng to confirm cost delta and exact resource size; (3) CS/SRE will be on-call during the perf window. If that all checks out, go ahead. @Lena @Dan please proceed.
Maya Chen: Thanks — I will: (a) get customer legal contact and PO request today, (b) finish remaining SQ answers (point Security to the three outstanding items), (c) publish a short runbook for SRE. @Jamal Ahmed can you stand by week 1 of the POC for on-call?
Jamal Ahmed: I can take on-call for the POC week. Need runbook + alert thresholds. Put runbook in #eng-oncall and ping me 24h before perf test. :thumbsup:
SecurityBot: SQ status update: 96/120 answered. Outstanding items flagged to Security team: KMS/HSM attestation, egress encryption diagram, subprocessors list. ETA for answers if prioritized: 48-72h.
Ravi Patel: I'll collect PO and customer legal contact this afternoon. Also putting the 25% discount approval in the deal doc and forwarding Marcus's note to the customer as conditional exec approval.
Lena Ortiz: Drafting addendum now, will share as a comment in the deal doc for internal review. If customer signs, Legal will countersign same day.
Dan S.: Once PO or billing waiver visible, I'll run the redwoodctl command and send allocation confirmation. Also creating a temporary route in our routing table for the Dedicated pool during the perf window.
Maya Chen: Action items recap (I'll update the deal doc): 1) Sales: PO + legal contact (Ravi) — due today EOD. 2) Legal: pilot addendum draft (Lena) — due EOD. 3) Security: KMS attestation + egress diagram (Security team) — ETA 48-72h. 4) Eng: allocate Dedicated once PO present (Dan) — will confirm capacity size & cost. 5) SRE: on-call & runbook (Jamal) — Jamal to confirm. 6) Exec: Marcus approves up to 25% discount conditional on above (Marcus). I'll post a status update in 3 hours. :eyes:
Marcus Vega: Good. Move forward on that cadence. Keep me posted if any legal or security gaps remain after Lena/Security wrap up. :white_check_mark:
